multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which is a measurable analysis question?

choice.div: "What share of accounts active on 1 January cancelled before 31 March, and does that exceed the 12% threshold for changing the retention offer?"

div.p: Population, window, metric and threshold are all stated. The others cannot be answered unambiguously.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Two teams report churn of 4% and 9%. What is the most likely cause?

choice.div: Different metric definitions — the population or window differs.
One team made an arithmetic error.

div.p: Most metric disputes are definition disputes. Writing the formula and population before querying prevents them.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Why does a spec need a threshold before the analysis starts?

choice.div: It defines what result would change the decision, which stops the report becoming decoration.
It guarantees the data is accurate.
It makes the dashboard load faster.

div.p: The threshold connects analysis to action. Without it, any result can be published and ignored.

choiceresponse.p: Which belong in a measurable spec? Select all that apply.

div.p: A spec defines the measurement and its purpose, never the answer it hopes for.
